name: Leyenda del Milagro Añejo
place: Los Altos, the highlands of Jalisco, Mexico

facts.base: Blue agave from the Jalisco Highlands, distilled twice in pot and column stills
facts.age: At least a year in oak, as añejo requires; accounts range from 12 to 24 months
facts.cask: American oak barrels, no larger than the 600 litres the añejo rule allows
facts.law: Tequila, 100% blue agave; añejo means at least one year in oak casks of at most 600 litres

made: The agave is the Silver's: blue agave from Los Altos, the highlands of Jalisco, cooked slowly, partly in brick ovens, then fermented and distilled twice, through a pot still and a column still. The new spirit goes into American oak barrels and rests for at least a year, accounts ranging from 12 to 24 months, before it is cut to 40 per cent and bottled. The wood turns it gold and lays caramel and vanilla over the cooked agave.
taste: Toasted oak, caramel and vanilla on the nose, with cooked agave and a little coconut. The palate is round and soft, butterscotch, baked agave and gentle spice, and the finish is warm, of medium length and lightly dry.

lines.s10: Leyenda del Milagro Añejo is a highland tequila rested at least a year in American oak: caramel, vanilla and cooked agave.
lines.s20: Milagro Añejo is 100% blue agave tequila from the Jalisco Highlands, aged at least a year in American oak barrels. The oak gives it caramel, vanilla and toasted coconut over the cooked agave, round and soft, a tequila to sip slowly.
lines.s45: This is Leyenda del Milagro Añejo, an aged tequila made from 100% blue agave grown in Los Altos, the highlands of Jalisco. The agave is cooked slowly, distilled twice, through a pot still and a column still, and rested in American oak barrels for at least a year, as the añejo rule requires. In the glass it is caramel, vanilla and toasted oak over baked agave, with a little coconut and spice, round and warm. We pour it neat at room temperature in a copita or a snifter, or over one large cube. Milagro was founded in Mexico City in 1998; its name means the legend of the miracle.
lines.sale: Milagro Añejo is highland agave after a year and more in American oak, caramel and vanilla over the agave. Pour it neat after dinner, or try it in a Mexican Coffee.

serve.neat: Neat at room temperature, given a minute in the glass.
serve.rocks: Over one large cube on request; the oak and caramel hold up to a little chill.
serve.glass: A copita, a small snifter or a tulip; a rocks glass over ice.
serve.classic: The Mexican Coffee, with coffee liqueur, hot coffee and cream; an añejo Old Fashioned too.

guest: Milagro Añejo is a 100% blue agave tequila rested at least a year in American oak: caramel, vanilla and toasted coconut over the agave, for sipping neat.
story: Two university friends founded Milagro in Mexico City in 1998, wanting a tequila with something of the city's creative life in it, and took their agave from Los Altos, the highlands of Jalisco. The range stands on three: the silver, unaged; the reposado, rested a few months; and the añejo, which rests longer than either. Añejo is simply the Spanish for aged, and under the tequila rules it means at least a year in oak casks of no more than 600 litres.
watch: Añejo means at least a year in oak; a reposado rests two months or more but under a year. Never pour one for the other.
A second, amber Leyenda del Milagro stands below the liqueurs: read the neck before pouring. This one says AÑEJO.
Asked its age: the label gives no single figure. The rule makes one year the least, and published accounts range from 12 to 24 months.
Not the Select Barrel Reserve Añejo, a separate Milagro bottling aged longer in American and French oak.

recall.prompt: What is Leyenda del Milagro Añejo, and how is it aged?
recall.answer: A 100% blue agave tequila from the Jalisco Highlands, distilled in a pot still and a column still, then rested at least a year in American oak barrels, 12 to 24 months by published accounts, at 40% ABV. Caramel, vanilla and coconut; poured neat.

quiz.q: What is the minimum time a tequila must rest in oak to be labelled añejo?
quiz.explain: One year. Two months is the reposado minimum and three years the extra añejo minimum.

quiz.q: Up to what cask size does the añejo rule allow?
quiz.explain: 600 litres: an añejo rests in oak casks no larger than that, so the wood stays in close touch with the spirit.

quiz.q: In which oak does Milagro Añejo rest?
quiz.explain: American oak, which gives the caramel, vanilla and coconut. The Select Barrel Reserve Añejo adds French oak.
